Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Heys!

My question revolves around a Vast Wealth action which finds a vehicle, but the minion performing the action already has a vehicle. I know the ruling that the new vehicle is burned and no cost is paid  [TOM 19950407] , but if NRA PAC is in play, do they get to unlock in this case?

> Name: Vast Wealth
> [Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:PTo, Third:U, KoT:U, FB:PTr1]
> Cardtype: Master
> Put this card on a ready minion you control. If you control this minion, they can equip with the first equipment you find in your library as a +1 stealth action (working down from the top; requirements and cost apply as normal; shuffle afterward).
> Artist: Kaja Foglio; William O'Connor
>
> Name: NRA PAC
> [Third:R, KoT:R]
> Cardtype: Event
> Government.
> Any minion who successfully performs an equip action unlocks at the end of the turn.
> Artist: Eric Lofgren
>
NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
An attempt to provide an explanation for the ruling.

The reasoning is that Vast Wealth provides a "search for a card" and an "equip action" in one.... the provided action if not blocked and reaches resolution is considered successful even if it "fizzles" because the requirements/adherence to limitations cannot be met...and as a successful action that "fizzles" in its resolution triggers the NRA PAC´s unlocking effect as it only cares about the status of the action and not about the resolution of the effect.
